title: PTPRS mediates invasion of tetanus neurotoxin into the central nervous system
title_zh: PTPRS介导破伤风神经毒素进入中枢神经系统的侵袭
abstract: Tetanus neurotoxin (TeNT) invades the central nervous system (CNS) via retrograde transport through motoneurons. Whether a host factor is needed to mediate TeNT trafficking has remained unknown. Here, using pull-down and mass spectrometry analysis, and by developing a luciferase-based in vivo transport assay, we identify receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase sigma (PTPRS; PTPσ) as the retrograde transport receptor for TeNT. Global or motoneuron-specific PTPRS knockout (KO) abolishes TeNT entry into the CNS in mouse models. PTPRS-TeNT interactions occur in endosomes, prevent toxin translocation, and direct TeNT trafficking in neurons. Structural studies establish that the TeNT light chain and belt region bind to the immunoglobulin domain of PTPRS. Disrupting TeNT-PTPRS interactions blocks TeNT trafficking into the spinal cord; consistently, a PTPRS-binding-deficient TeNT mutant induces botulism-like flaccid paralysis. Thus, PTPRS is the host factor mediating TeNT trafficking into the CNS, revealing a targetable pathway for post-entry intervention and drug delivery into the CNS.
abstract_zh: 破伤风神经毒素（TeNT）通过运动神经元的逆行运输进入中枢神经系统（CNS）。是否需要宿主因子介导TeNT的运输一直未知。本文通过亲和捕获与质谱分析，并开发基于荧光素酶的体内运输测定，鉴定了受体蛋白酪氨酸磷酸酶σ（PTPRS；PTPσ）为TeNT的逆行运输受体。全局或运动神经元特异性PTPRS敲除（KO）在小鼠模型中消除了TeNT进入CNS的能力。PTPRS-TeNT相互作用发生在内体中，阻止毒素转移并引导TeNT在神经元中的运输。结构研究表明，TeNT的轻链和束区与PTPRS的免疫球蛋白结构域结合。破坏TeNT-PTPRS相互作用可阻止TeNT进入脊髓；与此一致，缺乏PTPRS结合能力的TeNT突变体会诱发类似肉毒杆菌的瘫痪。由此可见，PTPRS是介导TeNT进入CNS的宿主因子，揭示了可针对的途径，用于后期干预和药物递送进入CNS。
